Multimedia - various (Xenial & newer)

PPA description

Multimedia PPA (many audio & video related packages) for Xenial & newer.

*** Please always see https://launchpad.net/~savoury1 for general updates about this Launchpad site before contacting me or reporting any bugs! ***

*** Big thanks to all those who have donated to support this project, you are very directly helping to keep it alive! To all who have not donated: please do so if you can afford it, this project depends on donations. ***

If software at this site is useful to you then please consider a donation:

*** Donations: https://paypal.me/Savoury1 & https://ko-fi.com/Savoury1 ***
*** Also https://patreon.com/Savoury1 & https://liberapay.com/Savoury1 ***

A set of multimedia software packages providing notably newer versions of many well-used packages to the past 8+ years of Ubuntu-based LTS releases.

*** Install ***

NOTE FOR ALL: Various packages here (eg. alsa-plugins-extra, chromaprint, gstreamer1.0-libav, libquicktime, mplayer, obs-studio) are built against FFmpeg 4.4 and depend on FFmpeg 4.4 to run. To install any such packages depending on FFmpeg 4.4 do these steps first for successful installation:

  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg4
  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/multimedia
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get upgrade && sudo apt-get dist-upgrade

Notes for Xenial & Bionic: The obs-studio package is built against a newer display driver stack than in Xenial or Bionic, so for this an additional PPA is required. Add this command at the top of the list above to install:

  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/display

This will upgrade the display stack including Mesa, Xserver, Wayland, and many more, so be sure you want this before proceeding. As always, remember to do a full backup prior to such major upgrading of the current system!

Also, linphone-cli 4.4.35 can be co-installed with linphone 3.6.1 through some packaging trickery with renaming the source to linphone3 and renaming various binary packages with appropriate Conflicts/Replaces. However, the co-installation can only be done by installing linphone-cli first and then linphone 3.6.1 so linphone must be uninstalled first if already installed.

Notes for Xenial: Some packages are built with and require GCC >= 7 (such as Guitarix and Intel-MediaSDK). Default Xenial GCC is 5.4.0 so GCC 7.5.0 built at ppa:savoury1/toolchain is copied to ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg4 making it easier for guitarix and libmfx1 installation on Xenial-based systems.

Also, gstreamer1.0-qt5 & obs-studio do not build with old Qt 5.5.1 (Xenial default) so they are built with Qt 5.9.5 and require Qt >= 5.9 to install. Thus, to install gstreamer1.0-qt5 or obs-studio on Xenial these steps are necessary first (Qt/KDE upgrades go together due incompatibility issues):

  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/qt-xenial
  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/kde-xenial
  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/multimedia
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get upgrade && sudo apt-get dist-upgrade

Finally, various packages require GTK >= 3.22.0 (Xenial default is 3.18.9) so install of these packages requires ppa:savoury1/gtk-xenial as follows:

  sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/gtk-xenial
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get upgrade && sudo apt-get dist-upgrade

*** Updates ***

Update (9 Sep 2023): Latest Kodi 20.2 home theatre & media centre software is now available here. Note that ppa:savoury1/display is also required for 16.04 & 18.04 LTS as Kodi is built with the newer display drivers at that PPA. For 20.04 & 22.04 LTS the display PPA is optional though recommended.

Update (27 Nov 2022): Thanks to Joel A. requesting it, the CDEmu suite of software (including gcdemu, cdemu-daemon, libmirage) is now here in full.

Update (5 Sep 2022): Major OBS Studio 28.0.1 upgrade now available! Built with obs-browser (CEF-based) & obs-websocket (remote control) support, as well as AJA NTV2 I/O device support and more! Requires fairly new Qt (for Xenial & Bionic https://launchpad.net/~savoury1/+archive/ubuntu/qt-5-15).

*** Build ***

This PPA has build dependencies on:

  ppa:savoury1/build-tools
  ppa:savoury1/backports
  ppa:savoury1/python
  ppa:savoury1/fonts
  ppa:savoury1/graphics
  ppa:savoury1/ffmpeg4

Additionally, for Xenial and Bionic:

  ppa:savoury1/tex-2019
  ppa:savoury1/display (specific builds only)

Additionally, for Xenial only:

  ppa:savoury1/toolchain
  ppa:savoury1/gtk-xenial
  ppa:savoury1/qt-xenial
  ppa:savoury1/vlc3
  ppa:savoury1/gcc-defaults-7 (specific builds only)

Note: Both the display & vlc3 PPA are only required for obs-studio builds and qt-xenial is only required for building gstreamer1.0-qt5 (for Xenial).

Adding this PPA to your system

You can update your system with unsupported packages from this untrusted PPA by adding ppa:savoury1/multimedia to your system's Software Sources. (Read about installing) 

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:savoury1/multimedia
sudo apt update
